verdict.rationale: Postman docs show test/scripts run against live responses (postman-docs-12, 17), API governance checks against configured spec rules (postman-docs-22), and Playwright integration that explicitly 'validates API calls against Postman Collections' during live traffic capture (postman-docs-26) — all directly relevant to catching drift between live responses and a contract. However there is no dedicated first-party 'contract testing' feature name or OpenAPI-schema-diff documentation, and no independent/hands-on evidence of drift detection in practice. missing for 10: explicit contract/schema-validation feature docs, independent corroboration of drift-catching in real pipelines.
